reviewer: lifecycle_review (separate AI-assisted source review and implementation lane)

results.meaning: Three replacement-allocation cases lose old wallet; saved-verification success survives changed password; no generated-only state/retry yet.
All three product fixes passed; generated-state test expected wording different from coordinator English locale.
Seven files executed; sole failure test expected guessed retry button name. Other six files and 13 of 14 verification tests passed.
Final saved-verification tests after aligning expected labels with coordinator English catalog; no product change from preceding broad run.

coverage: Focused Vitest tests used --coverage=false --maxWorkers=1, Node22.23.5, 768MiB heap. No browser, whole-app typecheck/lint or coverage pass inferred.

findings.cause: session.install cleared current wallet before summarizing and allocating replacement boxes; failure could erase original keys and leave partial new boxes undisposed.
findings.fix: Stage complete summary and boxes first; dispose partially staged boxes on failure; wipe incoming mutable scalars in finally; only then clear/install/notify.
findings.regression: session.atomicity.test.ts exercises failure at each of the three box allocations through actual RecoveredMasterKeys.install, preserves public identity/custody/revision/private access and verifies cleanup; success emits exactly one completed session.
findings.independent_review: recovery_recon inspected session.ts and test and reported no introduced source blocker.

findings.cause: Editing saved-backup passphrase left previous verification-success state visible.
findings.fix: Clear previous result and error when password input changes.
findings.regression: StealthExportVerification.test.tsx verifies result clears immediately, before any new check.

findings.cause: Root established generated encrypted backup was discarded after browser download failure; stages could not distinguish generation from start.
findings.fix: Root retains encrypted generated artifact and retry callback; this lane exposes explicit generated-only and initiated statuses without inferring retention or recoverability.
findings.regression: StealthExportVerification.test.tsx proves retry callback cannot itself set retained/verified state and explicit downloadStarted prop controls stage.

review_notes: Candidate verifyStealthExport authenticates and validates through existing codec, exposes public metadata only and disposes recovered boxes before return, including cancellation/session-change failure.

Master replacement consent is bound to exact held export object, current operation and session revision. Vault-only recoverability is reread on confirmation; losing it requires stronger sole-copy warning.

Changing credential during raw confirmation did not show an authority bypass: final proof must still match current loaded keys; selected payment/RPC/session remain independently bound. No change made solely on suspicion.
This lane adds no storage, network calls, crypto primitive, dependency, release gate relaxation or plaintext secret retention.
Broader full-app browser/coverage/typecheck/lint and final integration remain coordinator responsibilities; focused passes do not establish product release readiness.
